1.2.2.2-r2.burton_quote: A Cook of old was a base knave (as Livy complains), but now a great man in request: Cookery is become an art

1.2.2.2-r3.burton_quote: Bishop himself (if he belie them not) with his Chaplain will stand by and do as much
1.2.2.2-r3.translation: [the Bishop,] a stout drinker, ... when the prince drains a huge bowl.

1.2.2.2-r4.burton_quote: How they love a man that will be drunk, crown him and honour him for it, hate him that will not pledge him, stab him, kill him
1.2.2.2-r4.translation: Incredible to say, how much of this liquor this immoderate nation can take.

1.2.2.2-r5.burton_quote: he is the best servitor, and the honestest fellow, saith Alexander Guagninus, that drinketh most healths to the honour of his master

1.2.2.2-r6.burton_quote: They more offend in too sparing diet, and are worse damnified, than they that feed liberally, and are ready to surfeit
